```{r}
#| label: fig-model_diag2_wp2
#| fig-width: 16
#| fig-height: 5
#| out.height: "75%"
#| fig-cap: "Accuracy-calibration trade-off induced by the internal modelling choices."


# read data ---------------------------------------------------------------

diag_path <- project_path("data/predictions/tckf_diag.rds")

tckf_diag_components <- read_rds(diag_path)


# component-level summary -------------------------------------------------

sku_diagnostics <- tckf_diag_components |>
  filter(
    !is.na(yhat),
    censorship_type == "none"
  ) |>
  group_by(
    diag_spec, diag_lambda_choice, diag_cp_mode,
    series_category, series_type, store, product
  ) |>
  summarise(
    sku_rmse = sqrt(mean((yhat - actual_demand)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    sku_cov = mean(
      actual_demand <= upper_q95,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

diag_summary_plot <- sku_diagnostics |>
  group_by(diag_spec, diag_lambda_choice, diag_cp_mode) |>
  summarise(
    mean_rmse = mean(sku_rmse, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_rmse = sd(sku_rmse, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_cov = mean(sku_cov, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_cov = sd(sku_cov, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# accuracy-calibration plot ----------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  diag_summary_plot,
  aes(
    x = mean_rmse,
    y = mean_cov,
    colour = diag_cp_mode,
    shape = diag_lambda_choice
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      xmin = mean_rmse - 1.96 * se_rmse,
      xmax = mean_rmse + 1.96 * se_rmse
    ),
    orientation = "y",
    width = 0,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_cov - 1.96 * se_cov,
      ymax = mean_cov + 1.96 * se_cov
    ),
    width = 0,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  # geom_hline(
  #   yintercept = 0.95,
  #   colour = "#e74c3c",
  #   linetype = "dashed",
  #   linewidth = 0.65
  # ) +
  facet_wrap(~diag_spec) +
  labs(
    x = "Mean RMSE (Point Accuracy)",
    y = "Empirical 90% Coverage",
    colour = "Conformal Mode",
    shape = "Lambda Choice"
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "global" = "#ffb343",
      "rolling" = "#2D68C4"
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "sans", base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(
      colour = "#6d8196",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "grey92", linewidth = 0.35),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2b48"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2b48"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(colour = "#1a2b48"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = "#1a2b48"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", colour = "#1a2b48"),
    legend.text = element_text(colour = "#1a2b48"),
    plot.title = element_text(colour = "#1a2b48")
  )

```
